answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies including the senate, while the vice president for studies is not explicitly stated as a member.
The chancellor is responsible for the budget, and each body handles only its delimited kind of question.
Appointment matters are handled separately from study programmes and university leadership roles.
Deans lead faculties and chair their councils, not the vice president for studies.
The vice president for studies is responsible for degree programmes across the university, but study commissions belong to specific faculty matters.
Examination matters are handled by specific boards per the principle of delimited questions.
Research funding is an internal faculty round handled by its own members.
Module revision is handled by a specific working group for a degree programme.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled within a fixed budget by its own group.
Orientation week planning is a separate specific committee.
